title: Noor and the Undertow
author: Ada Almeida
blurb: Sable Joubert, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
